items.reason: No file in this area calls the server itself: no database client, no remote function, no web request. The tool list finds no server route here. Reads and writes go to the phone's own database with bound values. The only outside reads are a Hevy share page opened in a hidden in-app browser, which may only load hevy.com, and the gym push shown while the app is open, which is handed to the shop code. Deleting a workout asks the phone-sync code in another folder to update the gym leaderboard later.

Apps cannot read any server table from this area, because it touches none. Every table it uses (records, progress photos, routines, folders, settings) lives in the phone's own database, so there is no gym-to-gym boundary for a server test to prove. No database test file is tied to this area.
Rule applied: this area touches no server table, so no table lacks a cross-gym test and no finding is due.
Rule applied: no live cross-gym attempt was run. Only code and the scan files were read.

The secrets scan has no hit in this folder and the area's key-pattern list is empty. A search of the area's files for key-shaped text found nothing. The only addresses are Hevy and help-page links in comments, the fixed Hevy link pattern and the watch app's store id.
No AI or paid-service key is read or used here. Nothing in this area calls a paid service, and the share-as-text file keeps body weight out of what members paste into AI chats.
No sign-in, PIN or session handling in the workout, record, photo, routine and watch helpers of this area.

Typed and imported text (routine names, imported routines) reaches the phone database only as bound values. A pasted Hevy link is rebuilt from letters, digits, dashes and underscores only, so nothing else reaches the hidden browser. That browser refuses any page outside hevy.com. What the page sends back is checked for shape and cut to size. A picked routine file is size-checked before it is read and then checked by the routine-file reader.

Nothing here uploads. The profile photo, progress photos and workout photos are copied into the app's own folders and stay on the phone. The Drive backup leaves them out; progress photos go into Android's own backup only when the member turns that on. Deleting removes only the app's own copies.

No join code or gym page is made or opened here. The only links are a Hevy share link the member pastes, the trainer's video links from their own gym's plans (kept on the phone and wiped when the member leaves), and the watch app's fixed store page.

The area uses the phone's file sharing, photo picker, file picker, file storage and in-app browser libraries. Only the sharing library, which sends routine files out, is flagged by the dependency scan. That fault is already recorded and is reused here. The spreadsheet and navigation library alerts do not touch this folder: the Strong import here reads text with the app's own CSV reader. The repo-wide gap (dependency alerts switched off) is reused too.
